verdict.rationale: Extend's core product surface — extraction, classification, confidence scores, citations, agentic OCR, and form-filling — generates AI-derived structured insights from user documents directly inside the platform, and this is corroborated by a positive hands-on community review of extraction accuracy. Missing for 10: no evidence of broader cross-document analytics/trend-style 'suggestions' beyond per-document extraction, and no independent benchmark of insight quality.
